name: Hawaii Import Parts Inc
old_description: Since 1985, our experienced team has been committed to serving you with excellence every single day.
about:
Hawaii Import Parts Inc was founded in 1985 in Honolulu, Hawaii. The company operates as a supplier of foreign automotive parts and accessories, with a focus on European vehicles. No information about ownership structure or founders is publicly disclosed.

The business maintains a broad inventory of replacement components for foreign vehicles, including brakes, vision parts, belts, hoses, engine oil, chemicals, and filters. It positions itself as a source for hard-to-find parts for European makes, serving both retail customers and repair professionals. The company describes its inventory as vast and emphasizes the ability to locate the right part for a given vehicle.

The company’s customer base includes owners of foreign automobiles and automotive service shops in the Honolulu area seeking OEM-quality or aftermarket components for European brands. No specific industry sectors beyond automotive aftermarket are mentioned.

Hawaii Import Parts emphasizes its team’s combined experience of more than 60 years and a commitment to daily excellence in helping customers locate the correct part. The firm highlights superior product quality as a differentiator and states it has been committed to serving customers with excellence since 1985.
